findings.description: Eight spec scenarios added in round 2 adjudication ('Coverage footer shape', 'Target resolution precedence', 'Unique name resolves', 'Direction both labels sections' in codebase-analysis/spec.md; 'Frontmatter omits triggers and sets Architecture category', 'Skill markdown ends with required tail sections', 'Manifest declares portable distribution and atlas dependencies', 'Sibling skill paths use skill-base-dir form' in skill-workflow/spec.md) are not mapped under '**Spec scenarios**' in tasks.md, and Task 1.1's test description omits test cases for direction-both section labels, precedence resolution, and multi-language footer formatting.

plan-findings.md claims 'Ledger items from rounds 1–2 retired after adjudication (\'retired\' is not reopened on merge)', but .review-ledger/ledger.json emptied items to [] and reset next_id: 1 rather than recording the adjudicated items with status 'retired', breaking the documented merge protection.

In session-log.md under '## Phase: Plan Review (2026-09-16)', '### Next Steps' is placed prematurely between Decisions 1-4 and Decisions (round 2) 5-7, stating to re-run converge before the round 2 decisions are recorded.
